briefdescription.para: Scan the ringbuf for the delimiter byte.

simplesect.para: 1-based position of the first delimiter, or 0 if not found.

briefdescription.para: Rewind producer head to discard an overflowing partial frame without touching tail.

parameterdescription.para: Stream in delimiter mode whose backing ring buffer is full.

briefdescription.para: Initialize a stream with a caller-owned backing buffer.

parameterdescription.para: Backing array (caller-owned, must outlive the stream).
Size of backing array. Usable capacity is size - 1.

briefdescription.para: Set the byte threshold for readability.

detaileddescription.para: When set to N > 0, syn_stream_readable() returns true only when at least N bytes are in the buffer. Set to 0 to revert to default (readable when any bytes are available).
When enabled, syn_stream_readable() returns true only when the delimiter byte is present in the buffer. Pair with syn_stream_read_line() to consume one delimited chunk at a time.
Delimiter mode takes precedence over threshold mode.

simplesect.para: Overflow & Resynchronization: If an oversized packet fills the stream buffer without a delimiter, the stream automatically flushes the corrupted packet, enters a resync state, and discards trailing bytes until the delimiter arrives. This guarantees protothreads on PT_STREAM_WAIT wake ONLY on 100% complete frames.

briefdescription.para: Disable delimiter mode, reverting to default or threshold mode.

detaileddescription.para: ISR-safe (single-producer). Writes up to len bytes. Returns the number actually written (may be less if the buffer fills up).

briefdescription.para: Put a single byte into the stream.

simplesect.para: true if the byte was stored, false if the buffer is full.

briefdescription.para: Check if the stream is readable (mode-aware).

detaileddescription.para:
Behavior depends on configured mode:
Delimiter mode: true if the delimiter byte is in the buffer.
Threshold mode: true if count >= threshold.
Default: true if any bytes are available.
Delimiter mode takes precedence over threshold mode.

simplesect.para: true if the stream has data meeting the readability criteria.

briefdescription.para: Read up to max_len bytes from the stream.

detaileddescription.para: Non-blocking — returns 0 if the buffer is empty. Does not respect threshold or delimiter; reads whatever is available.

briefdescription.para: Read up to and including the next delimiter byte.

detaileddescription.para: Reads bytes from the stream into buf, stopping after the first delimiter byte (which is included in the output). If no delimiter is found in the buffer, returns 0 and reads nothing.
Pair with PT_STREAM_WAIT in delimiter mode to wait for a complete line: PT_STREAM_WAIT(pt,&stream); n=syn_stream_read_line(&stream,buf,sizeof(buf));

simplesect.para: Number of bytes read (0 if no delimiter found or empty).

briefdescription.para: Return the number of bytes currently in the stream.
Return the number of free bytes available for writing.
Discard all data in the stream.
